description: Romanian company legal representatives from the ONRC open data (data.gov.ro, CC BY 4.0, monthly national snapshot): every mandate published for every registration of the CUI (administrators, permanent representatives of corporate administrators, general director, supervisory board and directorate members, liquidators, judicial and special administrators), with the register's Romanian label, a closed-list family (role.famille) and the nature (natural person or entity, inferred from the presence of a birth date); sorted by family then name, duplicates across re-registrations merged; `aucun_mandat_publie` is measured on the complete snapshot. Name and role only: birth date, birthplace and domicile published by the source are never stored. Legal persons only (sole traders and family enterprises are refused 404). 503 fail-closed when the monthly snapshot is missing or older than 70 days. Paid via x402 ($0.01). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

cui.description: Romanian CUI / fiscal code, 1 to 10 digits, with or without the RO prefix, e.g. 412052 or RO412052

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_romanian_company_officers

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
